# Plan: Move tracked generated files to CI builds and release artifacts

## Current state

§ 2.1
Master 4cfab47, then PR #6 (b0e31f7), then PR #7 (c7bb034: one shared bin/<triple> at the repository root built by setup-dev-env.sh, plan_bin_dir resolving it, the flake on newest-stable rust). Four classes of generated files are tracked: (1) planning/bin/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/rjq, a 2.9 MB binary committed in e8bdaef (register T70a - its blob left the index in this plan's goal 01); (2) the five compiled libraries planning/scripts/plan-{core,crypt,document,progress,table}-lib.sh, built by planning/scripts/build-plan-libs.sh from planning/scripts/lib/<group>/*.sh, freshness asserted by planning/tests/test-plan-libs-build.sh; (3) planning/REVIEWER.md, generated from planning/SKILL.md by planning/scripts/generate-reviewer.sh and pinned to SKILL.md's SHA-256, freshness asserted by planning/tests/test-reviewer-projection.sh; (4) PORTABILITY.md, generated from portability-rules.json plus a PORTABILITY() marker scan by ./generate-portability.sh (requires rjq on PATH), freshness asserted by planning/tests/test-portability-contract.sh and by coupling.tsv rows through blast-radius.sh. A fifth class exists in declared-but-unbuilt form only: the plan-overview renderer binary (src/plan-overview crate, five binaries.tsv rows, installer artifact rows, CI builds the crate per target) - its artifacts are already untracked and already reconciled on master. Master also already reconciled parts of this plan's surface: tests/test-skill-files-manifest.sh skips absent planning/bin/* rows; tests/test-release-package.sh skips absent plan-overview artifacts and exempts fixtures while still byte-comparing every packed file against the repository copy (property 2, which breaks when libs and REVIEWER.md are untracked); package.json prepack still runs only the manifest and register-schema tests; .gitignore gained .ci-bin/ and the root bin/ for local builds. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) has jobs test, test-bash32, plan-crypt, chat-binary, rjq-binary, shellcheck, installer-build, mermaid-render, plus render-artifacts.yml from PR #7; the three rust jobs upload per-target artifacts; no release or npm-publish job exists; publishing is manual per DEVELOPMENT.md. Consumers: installer skill_files() (installer/src/50-manifest.sh) delivers REVIEWER.md, the five compiled libs, binaries.tsv and platform-conditional rjq and plan-overview artifact rows; installer/build-release.sh builds the dist tarball and hard-errors on a listed-but-missing file; the npm package ships planning/ wholesale (files names planning/bin explicitly) minus lib sources; install.sh sources the delivered plan-document-lib.sh at runtime; the benchmark capsule copies all of planning/scripts/ plus REVIEWER.md when present, and its git-archive path for tag runs cannot carry untracked files. The governing rule is planning/MAINTAINER.md section 2.16 and register tasks T70, T70a and T73; T71 on master is the planning/SKILL.md split and T72 is PR #7's shared-bin installed half.

## Desired outcome

§ 3.1
git ls-files contains none of the four generated classes; .gitignore covers each; and every consumer still works. Concretely: a clean checkout plus one documented bootstrap command yields a green ./run-tests.sh; npm pack --dry-run produces a package containing all five compiled libs, REVIEWER.md and no lib sources; installer/build-release.sh produces a dist tarball whose install delivers a working skill set; the benchmark capsule contains built libs and a REVIEWER.md for both its live-tree and git-archive paths; and the four freshness gates have been rewritten from compare-against-committed to build-and-verify, with no gate downgraded - stale generated content must still fail something, not vanish into silence. The committed rjq blob is gone (T70a closed with this plan's commit).

## Approach

§ 4.1
Smallest class first to prove the untrack-and-reconcile pattern on one consumer set, then the classes with the widest blast radius. Goal 01 untracks the rjq binary blob (T70a): git rm --cached, gitignore the triple-shaped path, verify the manifest rule master b0e31f7 landed, add the install-time notice and the skip-copy path, the tracked-binary regression guard, manifest/map and docs. Goal 02 untracks the five compiled libs: gitignore, an ensure-built step in run-tests.sh that also generate-if-missing REVIEWER.md and runs the W37 rjq bootstrap when needed, test-plan-libs-build.sh rewritten from compare-against-committed to build-and-verify, the manifest test building first, prepack running the generators, AGENTS.md and DEVELOPMENT.md wording. Goal 03 untracks REVIEWER.md: test-reviewer-projection.sh builds to temp, role-context.sh refuses with an actionable message, plan-context-lib.sh omits with a stated reason, installer/build-release.sh and the capsule generate it, MAINTAINER.md wording. Goal 04 untracks PORTABILITY.md: the contract test regenerates to temp, the generator's --check compares two fresh builds, coupling.tsv rows flip, AGENTS.md and CODE-STYLE.md wording. Goal 06 reconciles the packaging-adjacent gates: test-release-package.sh byte-identity against fresh builds, test-mode-markers.sh building before scans. Goal 07 delivers rjq for local runs: bootstrap.sh building the crate into the gitignored path, the register-schemas guard. Goal 05 is the cross-cutting verification: clean-checkout bootstrap + full suite, npm pack contents, dist tarball contents and a scratch install, capsule completeness.

## Scope

§ 5.1
In scope: the four generated classes above; .gitignore entries; the generators as-is (build-plan-libs.sh, generate-reviewer.sh, generate-portability.sh); the consumer reconciliation named in the approach; the freshness gates' rewrite; documentation that states the committed-file contract (planning/MAINTAINER.md sections 1 and 2.8 cross-references, AGENTS.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, RELEASE.md, CODE-STYLE.md mentions of PORTABILITY.md, coupling.tsv); and the plan/step-level register updates T70a and T73 require. Out of scope: creating the CI release or npm-publish job (T70 owns the release pipeline; this plan only guarantees artifacts are buildable locally and in CI and names where each consumer gets them); the chat, plan-crypt and tony-the-pony binaries and their registries beyond the rjq blob removal; benchmark results (immutable evidence); TODO.json, BUGS.json and planning/binaries.tsv content changes beyond what untracking requires - the registers are hand-maintained data, not generated; and install.sh plus .npmignore, which are generated and tracked today but are deliberately excluded - the curl-pipe-bash entry point must exist in the repo raw tree, so untracking install.sh needs a bootstrap design of its own, recorded as an open question for a separate task.

## Affected areas

§ 6.1
planning/bin/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/rjq (untracked), .gitignore (four new sections); planning/scripts/plan-core-lib.sh, plan-crypt-lib.sh, plan-document-lib.sh, plan-progress-lib.sh, plan-table-lib.sh (untracked) with sources under planning/scripts/lib/ untouched; planning/REVIEWER.md (untracked) with planning/scripts/generate-reviewer.sh and planning/SKILL.md untouched; PORTABILITY.md (untracked) with generate-portability.sh and portability-rules.json untouched (the generator's --check mode changes semantics). Consumers: run-tests.sh; planning/tests/test-plan-libs-build.sh, test-reviewer-projection.sh, test-portability-contract.sh; tests/test-shipped-binaries.sh, test-skill-files-manifest.sh, test-release-package.sh, test-mode-markers.sh; installer/src/20-runtime-tools.sh, installer/src/60-install.sh, installer/build-release.sh; package.json (scripts.prepack); benchmark/planning/setup-benchmark.sh; coupling.tsv; planning/MAINTAINER.md, AGENTS.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, CODE-STYLE.md; TODO.json T70a/T73 notes and BUGS.json if execution files a defect. Regenerated, not hand-edited: install.sh, via installer/build.sh after installer/src changes.

## Constraints and decisions

§ 7.1
Tschallacka's decision (2026-08-31, MAINTAINER.md section 2.16): absolute - no generated files tracked, ever, including the text generators' outputs. Bash 3.2 and BSD userland portability hold for every changed script (CODE-STYLE.md, PORTABILITY.md rules); every edited shell script passes shellcheck -s bash. MAINTAINER.md section 2.1: each goal is one coordinated no-backwards-compatibility change updating producer, parser/validator, tests, manifest/map, install.sh skill_files and capsule copy together. install.sh is never hand-edited: changes go through installer/src/*.sh plus installer/build.sh. Register updates (T70a, T73 notes, any filed defect) land in the same change per the checklist step 8. Test and build commands run under resource-limited-testing/scripts/limited-run.sh. PORTABILITY.md is never hand-edited, before or after untracking. The repo is master's lineage: re-check origin/master before starting each goal; PR #7's shared-bin work (c7bb034) landed mid-execution and goal 01 plus the rjq bootstrap were rebased onto it.

## Risks and open questions

§ 8.1
Open questions and risks. (1) install.sh and .npmignore are themselves generated and tracked - excluded from this plan by decision, but the absolute rule leaves them as named exceptions; whoever owns the bootstrap design (likely a tiny committed entry stub that fetches the release tarball) must file that follow-up task. (2) The curl-pipe-bash install path loses the bundled rjq the moment the blob is untracked: master's skip rule plus W03/W34's notice is the stopgap, and T70 landing is the real fix - if T70 slips, register users on fresh installs cannot run the register helpers. (3) tests/test-register-schemas.sh and tests/test-rjq-active-references.sh need rjq on PATH; after untracking, CI builds it (existing rjq-binary job pattern) and local runs use the documented bootstrap - the suite must fail with that instruction, not with a bare command-not-found. (4) test-plan-libs-build.sh physically rewrites the libs mid-suite; once they are gitignored this is safe for git but the ensure-built order in run-tests.sh must precede every consumer, including the register tests. (5) The merge/codex-vs-master branch has landed as PR #6 (master b0e31f7); the pre-goal master re-check now covers drift from b0e31f7 onward, and goal 01's W02 was retargeted because master already implemented the skip-when-absent rule. (6) npm files negation semantics interact with .npmignore precedence; master's files list now names planning/bin explicitly, so the pack verification step must assert contents, not assume - a gitignored artifact may still be packaged or dropped depending on that interaction. (7) The benchmark git-archive path for tag runs silently omits untracked files - the capsule build step is mandatory there, and a capsule completeness check is part of goal 05. (8) plan-overview is a fifth declared-but-untracked artifact class; its consumers are already reconciled on master, but the tracking guard (W04) must cover it so a future commit cannot reintroduce it as a blob.

## Environment facts

§ 9.1
Verification happens on this Linux workstation (bash 5.x, GNU userland) against the repo working tree, and on GitHub Actions runners for the portability floor. No URL or auth is involved. Order: (1) run the documented bootstrap on a scratch clean checkout made with git archive or a fresh clone in TMPDIR; (2) ./run-tests.sh under the resource wrapper; (3) installer/build-release.sh and a scratch install from the produced tarball; (4) npm pack --dry-run and inspect the file list; (5) benchmark capsule smoke via setup-benchmark.sh against a tag checkout to prove the git-archive path builds its artifacts. Portability-floor proof for changed scripts comes from verify-both-shells.sh; the macOS CI legs carry the same suite.

## Approach decisions

§ 10.1
Delivery model: T73 makes every artifact buildable on demand and reconciles each consumer to build-or-fetch locally, while CI builds the same artifacts in its existing rust matrix jobs (which already upload) and, after T70, attaches them to releases; npm packages are assembled only after the generators run. Rejected: committing artifacts per release tag (that is the blob being removed); requiring a Rust toolchain at install time (raises runtime requirements, against the requires.tsv philosophy - shipping a static binary lowered them, removing the binary must not raise them back); vendoring a second copy of the generators' outputs anywhere in the tree. Untrack means git rm --cached plus .gitignore plus tests that build to temp or to the gitignored path; the freshness gates' wording changes from committed-file-must-be-fresh to no-stale-committed-copy-exists-and-generation-is-deterministic, and every gate keeps teeth (test-plan-libs-build.sh still byte-compares a fresh prod build against a just-built one and still asserts the 500-line cap, symbol-set and dev/prod behavior; test-reviewer-projection.sh still asserts the SHA-256 pin and marker set; test-portability-contract.sh still runs marker and banned-construct sweeps against its temp regeneration). Ordering rationale: rjq first because its consumer set is smallest and it closes T70a; libs second because 42 scripts source the facade and the suite itself rewrites them; REVIEWER.md third because its SHA pin makes its gate the most self-contained; PORTABILITY.md last because its gate is coupling-driven and its consumers are prose. The installer keeps its platform-conditional rjq row and gains a build-time presence check whose refusal names the release asset - keeping the row preserves the manifest contract and makes T70's download support a drop-in. Goal 05 verifies the whole surface rather than spreading end-to-end proof across goals 01-04, whose own definitions of done stop at their class boundary; the boundary between them is the bootstrap command, which goals 01-04 extend and 05 exercises.

## Assumptions

§ 11.1
Assumed rather than confirmed: (1) GitHub Actions remains the CI and GitHub releases the artifact home - if the host changes, the refusal texts and T70's design change, not the untracking; (2) the four named classes plus the excluded install.sh/.npmignore are the complete set of generated-and-tracked files - the survey covered the generator scripts found in the repo, but a generator outside survey scope would surface as a test-skill-files-manifest or mode-marker failure and joins T73 by the same pattern; (3) PR #7's shared-bin work landed mid-execution (master c7bb034) and was rebased onto goal 01; its setup-dev-env.sh is the canonical nix toolchain build and this plan's bootstrap.sh is the fallback that keeps the suite and prepack self-healing on hosts without nix; (4) npm publish stays a manual flow per DEVELOPMENT.md until T70 automates it, so this plan guarantees pack completeness, not publication; (5) rjq on PATH via the bootstrap is acceptable for local register work until T70 delivers install-time downloads - if Tschallacka prefers a different stopgap (symlink, nix profile), only the bootstrap documentation changes.

## UI classification

- UI affected: no
- Rationale: Build, packaging and installer surface only: no HTML, CSS, template, route or user-facing flow changes; the served-overview rung is exercised by the existing suite, not changed by it.
